name: Biology PhD
detailsNote: Fall 2027 date confirmed. Published stipend increase takes effect January 2027; individual offer and future updates control. School and college waiver wording differs.

documents: Official-issued transcript scans and degree proof when needed
Official English evidence unless approved degree route applies

applicationFee.note: Central recruitment/achievement waivers explicitly possible for complete international applications. School says no waivers, while newer college page invites manager contact; confirm program availability and eligibility before payment.

english.toefl: 100 legacy, each section 19; new 5 overall, Listening/Reading/Writing 4 and Speaking 3.5
english.note: IELTS Listening/Reading/Speaking at least 6.5, Writing 5.5. No MyBest. Qualifying degree-country or verified English-medium degree may establish proficiency; MOI may be requested. Degree completed before enrollment; documentation at least 30 days before start.

requirements.note: Four-year US bachelor or equivalent; master unnecessary. First year includes coursework, rotations and teaching. Recommendation letters may arrive later, but all are needed for a decision. Applications reviewed December–February, offers March, responses mid-April.

funding.note: GRA/GTA/fellowship support with tuition remission; students pay fees. Newer college page lists Fall 2026 stipend $37,500, rising to $38,400 January 2027, overriding older overview $33,500. No unconditional all-admitted or explicit international guarantee established.
